misconfigurations.scenario: SNS topic does not use server-side encryption
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: GetTopicAttributes omits KmsMasterKeyId for an active SNS topic
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Enable SNS server-side encryption with the AWS-managed SNS key or a reviewed customer-managed KMS key
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: SNS server-side encryption protects message bodies at rest. Select an AWS-managed or customer-managed KMS key that allows the required publishers and consumers, then verify delivery integrations after enabling encryption.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Return topic ARN and encryption-key identifier state only.
misconfigurations.notes: KMS permissions for AWS services publishing to the topic must be reviewed before remediation.

misconfigurations.scenario: SNS topic policy grants public access without a restricting condition
misconfigurations.alert_criteria: An Allow statement grants Principal=* or AWS=* a publish, subscribe, permission-management, or wildcard SNS action without a condition that restricts the caller, source account, source owner, organization, or source ARN
misconfigurations.recommendation_action: Replace the public statement with explicitly reviewed principals and source conditions
misconfigurations.recommendation_description_detailed: Unconditioned public topic policies can permit unauthorized publishing, subscription changes, or topic administration. Default SNS policies commonly use a wildcard principal together with an owner condition; those constrained statements must not be reported as public.
misconfigurations.output_notes: Return statement identifiers and matched action classes only. Do not return complete policy documents.
misconfigurations.notes: Condition-aware policy evaluation is required to avoid flagging the SNS default owner-restricted policy.
